title: Simkl Import list for anime not syncing after initial sync
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

Currently when adding an import list from simkl for anime it works fine for the initial sync when adding the import list. However anything I add to the list afterwards doesn't get pulled by sonarr.

### Expected Behavior

The list syncing every 6 hours with newly added items.


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Add simkl import list for anime
2. First sync succeeds
3. add new anime to simkl list
4. nothing gets added by syncs

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: TrueNas 25.10.3
- Sonarr: 4.0.17.2952
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Database: Sqlite 3.51.2
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

[sonarr.trace.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27127668/sonarr.trace.txt)

### Anything else?

I've played around a bit with the api of simkl and noticed that when sonarr is checking the last modified date of the lists on simkl it only checks the tv shows lists and not the one for anime. Resulting in it never picking up the newly added anime.

I can replicate this as well if I add an anime to my list and wait for a sync nothing happens, but if I make a change to my tv show lists and wait for the next sync suddenly the anime gets picked up as well. 

Should this method also check the anime part of the response instead of only the tvshow part?
https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/bf5d48c76a6a793b7d2adc540bb11d9c51bcc3cb/src/NzbDrone.Core/ImportLists/Simkl/SimklImportBase.cs#L100-L122
